title: Hostinger root startup deployment manifest refresh

phases.objective: Ensure the Hostinger root entrypoint regenerates the canonical Production deployment manifest before importing the nested HTTP API server, instead of bypassing the nested npm prestart lifecycle and retaining stale deployment identity.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The root runtime imports the canonical deployment-manifest generator, writes a Production-scoped manifest in the nested application directory, and only then changes the working directory and imports the nested server; manifest-generation failure prevents stale-identity startup.
steps: Resolve the nested http-generic-api application directory and canonical manifest generator path.
Import the existing deployment-manifest generator without duplicating its commit-source resolution logic.
Generate http-generic-api/deployment-manifest.json with the exact Production branch identity and the available deployment commit provenance.
Fail startup before changing the working directory or importing the server when manifest refresh fails.
Change the process working directory to the nested application directory only after manifest generation succeeds.
Import the nested server entrypoint and preserve the existing startup error boundary.
assertions: The Hostinger root startup path does not depend on npm invoking the nested package prestart script.
The canonical scripts/generate-deployment-manifest.mjs implementation remains the only manifest writer.
The manifest output path is exactly http-generic-api/deployment-manifest.json.
The manifest branch argument is exactly Production.
Manifest refresh completes before process.chdir and nested server import.
Manifest refresh failure prevents both process.chdir and nested server import.
No repository mutation, provider dispatch, credential access, SQL execution, migration apply, deployment command, restart command, or external send is introduced.

phases.objective: Promote the reviewed startup repair through protected Production, observe the Hostinger build and process activation, and require auth.mad4b.com /version and /deployment-info to report the exact resulting Production SHA and branch.
Add bounded diagnostics for unavailable Git metadata or deployment commit environment provenance without allowing startup with an ambiguous or stale manifest.
Exercise the repaired root startup path on an authorized non-production Hostinger application before future protected promotions.
Require exact deployed-SHA and Production-branch readback after every Hostinger root startup or protected Production promotion.
